0.original: Managingway seeks your aid with Ways who dream of playing music.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Speak with Pipingway in Greatest Endsvale.

2.original: Deliver the requested items to Pipingway.

24.original: Speak with Pipingway in Greatest Endsvale.

48.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, your timing is impeccable. I have good tidings─the melodies of the musicking station appear to have struck a proverbial chord with a number of our Ways, who have incidentally come to me with a request.

49.original: The music awoke something in them─the desire to play an instrument themselves. Naturally, we must nurture these burgeoning embers of passion within their hearts in a timely fashion, lest they be extinguished. I trust I can count on you?

50.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! It seems even more of our Ways have developed an interest in playing an instrument. Might I ask for your help once more? Your support would mean the world to them.

51.original: Assuming that's a yes, allow me to point you in the direction of Greatest Endsvale, where you will find Pipingway eager to share all of the details with you. Best of luck!

52.original: <beep> This supporter would be positively thrilled to replenish any and all necessary materials should the need arise!

53.original: There you are, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Allow me to bring you up to speed. We've already requested some of the engineers to draw up plans for fabricating wind instruments designed for paws like yours truly.

54.original: That said, we can hardly cobble together a random assortment of materials and call it a day. No, we need the finest components─ones suited to making an instrument sing, and not...er, scream? That, my esteemed artisan friend, is where you come in!

56.original: Good to see you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Wouldn't you know it─after hearing us play our new instruments, a bunch of our fellow Ways are now hoping to join us. So many, in fact, that we frankly can't keep up with the demand!

57.original: So...erm, we could really use your help again!

58.original: Please see if you can craft a tuning slide with this assortment of delicate metals!

59.original: Please see if you can craft a pipe with these exquisite woods we procured from Etheirys!

60.original: Please see if you can craft a lubricant with these materials! We must stick all manner of moving bits together, you know. Instruments are so delightfully odd!

61.original: Should you run out of materials, the doing supporter beside me can provide whatever you need.

62.original: How lovely, a materials request! <blip> <bleep> Bugger! It seems you already have a sufficient amount in your possession. You will have to deplete your present inventory before this supporter can assist you!

65.original: <blip> A materials request─how quaint! <beep> It is a delight to issue these supplies to you.

66.original: <blip> A materials request─how quaint! <beep> It is a delight to issue these supplies to you.

67.original: <blip> A materials request─how quaint! <beep> It is a delight to issue these supplies to you.

68.original: Do let me know when you've finished!

69.original: Oh, it's beautiful! We'll be able to make such wonderful instruments with this─not to mention music!

70.original: I will take this marvelous component to the engineers. Thank you so much for lending us a paw, and do give Managingway my regards!

71.original: You are returned. And by your countenance, I take it you were able to assist them with their production woes.

72.original: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You've played an instrumental role in helping our Ways see their dreams to fruition. I hope that you continue to do the same for others.
